definitions.iteration: Completed rollout collection + PPO/checkpoint cycle; not Adam update. Adam counters are separate.
definitions.collected_zero_reward: All journaled zero-reward turns, INCLUDING truncated/aborted trajectories; not a valid-failure count.
definitions.auxiliary: Strictly admitted all-failure groups. Additive: side buffer outside the48 mixed groups. All-failure: inside48.
definitions.sampled: Bernoulli sampling flags, including candidate/gate failures. Usable labels are separate.
definitions.denominators: Group journals are before final native pruning/shuffle/PPO epoch trimming. Auxiliary additive denominators are validated against exact manifests.
definitions.collection_groups: Completed journaled groups, not all submitted/in-flight/canceled groups.
definitions.causality: Descriptive counts/correlations; on-policy task/state distributions change and no causal attribution is claimed.

sampler_audit.evidence: Actual native argument dumps in collection.log; fixed-source filter/browser hashes identical through additive100.
sampler_audit.blacklist: The referenced file contains only a comment and no active hosts.
sampler_audit.mechanism: Native outcome-variance filtering collects until48 mixed groups; additive retains up to8 strict valid all-failure groups with at least one usable q=.2 ARM label.
sampler_audit.implication: Coverage falls when eligible failure groups/turns fall, despite constant q. Nf/48 also lowers auxiliary loss weight.
